subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Should fresh Telegram onboarding establish the first owner through a token-verified allowlist flow, or retain initial pairing and harden the policy only after owner approval?
rationale: Both choices change the first-run trust boundary and failure mode; repository behavior cannot determine the intended tradeoff between zero-config pairing and fail-closed verified owner capture.

options.title: Verified allowlist bootstrap
options.body: Generate a one-time challenge, accept only the matching sender, and write that numeric ID with dmPolicy allowlist for fresh setup.

options.title: Pair then auto-harden
options.body: Keep initial pairing, then switch an otherwise unset policy to the approved owner's allowlist after first-owner establishment.

options.title: Keep pairing default
options.body: Retain current pairing behavior and limit the change to warnings or separate abuse mitigations.

recommendation.title: Verified allowlist bootstrap
recommendation.body: Generate a one-time challenge, accept only the matching sender, and write that numeric ID with dmPolicy allowlist for fresh setup.

likelyOwner.reason: The live discussion and repeated Telegram onboarding history make this the strongest available owner for the trust-boundary decision.
